workflow: A sequence conversion records the input length and begins converting its elements one by one.
Converting an element invokes user-controlled code that mutates and clears the same sequence.
The conversion continues using the original length and accesses an element slot that the mutation removed.
The invalid element access dereferences a null or stale pointer, terminating the process instead of handling the mutation safely.
summary: Reentrant sequence mutation causes invalid later element access
decision_reason: The failure workflow is materially the same as reentrant conversion invalidating a backing resource before the outer operation’s later use: user-controlled conversion mutates the object being processed, the outer operation fails to revalidate or stabilize its state, and a subsequent access crashes.
